The OpenAPI document of each API this service publishes, as pages to read. A running service answers the same documents as JSON, at `/admin-api/openapi.json` and its equivalent on each API, and the [Endpoints](../endpoints.html) page lists what else it serves.

Every answer is checked against the model shown here before it is sent, and no answer carries a member its model does not list. A member shown as *any JSON* is one whose shape belongs to somebody else, and says whose. `.{key}` is a key that is data, and `[]` an element of a list.

| API | Base path | Operations |
|---|---|---|
| [Management API](admin-api.html) | `/admin-api` | 678 |
| [Admin console operations](admin-console-api.html) | `/admin-api/console` | 20 |
